newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil actor jailed for soap opera murder.
newsitem.headline: Brazil actor jailed for soap opera murder.

text.p: A Brazilian actor accused of murdering his screen lover was sentenced on Saturday to 19 years in jail, an official said.
After deliberating all night, a jury in Rio de Janeiro found 27-year-old Guilherme de Padua guilty of the 1992 killing of co-star Daniella Perez, a court official said.
Calling the crime "perverse" and "cowardly", the judge sentenced de Padua to 19 years detention, of which he has already served four. He was bundled immediately into a police van and taken to prison.
De Padua, a former stripper turned soap opera star, was accused jointly with his former wife Paula Thomaz, aged 23. She will stand trial separately.
The killing of the actress, then 22 years old, has gripped millions of Brazilian soap opera fans.
Many have watched its twists and turns as closely as the soap opera, "De Corpo e Alma" (Of Body and Soul) in which de Padua and his victim starred.
De Padua shot to fame as the brooding lover of sexy teenager Yasmin, played by Perez.

During his trial, he accused Thomaz of carrying out the murder in a fit of jealousy. He said he had had an affair with Perez because her mother, Gloria, was the script writer for the opera and it was in his "interests" to keep on her good side.
The trial has taken place under an intense media spotlight, the courthouse packed with television crews and journalists.

Outside, protesters demanding justice had been camping for days, including womens' rights groups that sprung up after the murder and pressure groups demanding an overhaul of Brazil's justice system, where prominent defendants often go free.
